subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the longest night of winter's deepest cold.
source_quote: On the longest night of winter's deepest cold, the keeper falls, the heart is sold.

subject: elapsed time
fact: Forty-one years pass in the corner of the library where Vareth has kept his office.
source_quote: He has been keeping this corner of the library for forty-one years, he says

subject: chasme count
fact: Three duels have been fought at Candlekeep over which polemic shelf gets the larger window.
source_quote: Three duels have been fought at Candlekeep over which polemic shelf gets the larger window. *Three*, in a library where nobody has dueled in two hundred years.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: The Keeper of Tomes is dead, and the First Reader summons the party through the emerald door before the Avowed awake.
source_quote: The Keeper of Tomes is dead! She wants you! Now, through the emerald door, before the avowed awake!

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: The Refectory ceiling is high enough that a hill giant could sit comfortably at one end and not embarrass herself.
source_quote: The Refectory was built for scholars, which meant the ceiling was high enough that a hill giant could have sat comfortably at one end and not embarrassed herself.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The theological document from Asha Vandree's chain mail — the Lolth/Zuggtmoy equivalence — was written in a hand that wanted very much to seem incidental.
source_quote: The theological document from Asha Vandree's chain mail — the Lolth/Zuggtmoy equivalence, written in a hand that wanted very much to seem incidental.

subject: Grygum school of thought
fact: A fourth school of theological thought has been proposed — one centered on fixed points around which actions must revolve, with constrained freedom between them.
source_quote: What if there are certain fixed points around which our actions must revolve? And the closer we come to one of those fixed points, the more constrained we are, but between them, perhaps we have a great deal of freedom of action.

subject: Grygum school of thought
fact: The Grygum school of thought was accidentally proposed and is now being treated by Vareth as the question of the age.
source_quote: I just proposed a school of theological thought by accident, and that an aging scholar with forty-one years in this corner of the library is now treating it as the question of the age.

subject: Candlekeep prophecy inventory
fact: The prophecies of Alaundo are recited daily; fulfilled ones are removed, leaving only the unfulfilled inventory.
source_quote: Whenever one came true, it was removed. What remained was the unfulfilled inventory.

subject: Glabbagool's confinement
fact: Glabbagool the grey ooze, confined in a bag of holding, has reached a breaking point and demands to be let out.
source_quote: Whatever Glabbagool had been doing in the bag all day — thinking, absorbing, trying to formalize whatever Zalthir had been patiently teaching him into monastic discipline — he was done with it. He wanted out.
